name: kensa-qa
description: ISTQB CTFL v4.0.1-grounded manual QA team for the Kensa TMS — Codex edition. Reuses the same 31 skills (21 ISTQB-grounded + 10 tooling) and bundles cross-platform Stop hooks for auto memory checkpoint and per-session debug logging. Test Lead + QA Engineer + Strategist agents install as Codex subagents.

interface.shortDescription: ISTQB-grounded manual QA team in your pocket
interface.longDescription: A coordinated manual-QA team for the Kensa test-management system. A Test Lead plans coverage and reviews; QA Engineers author checklists and test cases grounded in the ISTQB CTFL v4.0.1 syllabus. Ships 31 skills, cross-platform Stop hooks, and read-only SDLC analysis prompts (spec review, risk, test plan, traceability).
